who.value: buyer searching for a specific card

job.value: browse listings for the searched card and compare prices

questions.title: The screen's job is clear from the first screen
questions.why: The search 'mega gengar ex 23…', '3 results in Singapore' and a grid of card listings say this is search results.

questions.title: The action that does the job stands out most
questions.why: The listing grid fills the screen, with the price teaser as a single row above it.

questions.title: Every label says what happens when tapped
questions.why: 'See prices for Mega Gengar…', 'All categories', 'Delivery' and 'Filters' each say what they open.

questions.title: No terms this user wouldn't know
questions.why: The teaser's 'S$34' isn't labelled (market price? average?), and 'JP'/'EN' tags and 'Good Deal' are unexplained.

questions.title: Only asks what this user can decide at this stage
questions.why: Browsing and filtering need nothing the buyer doesn't know.

questions.title: Advanced detail is tucked away
questions.why: Price history sits behind the 'See prices…' row rather than on the page.

questions.title: Everything fits this stage and this user
questions.why: Everything serves comparing listings for this card.

questions.title: Little reading needed to act
questions.why: Titles, prices and short tags carry it.
